summary: New tests are the correct type (unit-level over MockWebServer real HTTP stubs, not mock-call assertions) and each asserts real behavior: returned SentMessage/List values, request path, request body shape, and log content. Coverage matches the TDD anchors: sendVideo/sendAudio/sendDocument happy-path + field-omission, inherited 429 retry and 5xx-exhaust (proving the shared seam, not a hand-rolled loop), album array mapping with all message-ids, caption-only-on-first-item, ok=false token-scrub parity, and empty-array error. No redundant tests. Existing sendText/sendPhoto suite and the single-message mapper are untouched and green.
coverage_notes: sendMediaGroup bot-not-found / terminal-4xx parity tests deliberately omitted: those paths are byte-identical to the shared seam already exhaustively covered by sendText_* tests; adding them would be redundant per the each-test-earns-its-place rule.
